HOW TO USE
widgets_values:
# Storyboard → Video (one click)

**1 · Your panels: pick one**
- **Option A: storyboard image.** Load the 3×3 storyboard from workflow 1. It's split into 9 panels automatically. Works on cloud too.
- **Option B: panels folder.** Paste the full path of a folder of sharp panels named in order (panel_01.png, panel_02.png …). Best quality, and you can drop or fix a panel.
- **Panel source:** `0` = storyboard image, `1` = panels folder.

**2 · One prompt per transition.** Transition 1 = panel 1 → 2, and so on. The loop makes one segment per pair of panels: 9 panels = 8 prompts. In each prompt write:
- her action and the camera, in separate sentences
- a speed plan: *real time* for fast moves, *slow motion* for hang moments
- where EVERY hand and prop ends up, so nothing vanishes
- "one continuous shot, no cuts"

**3 · Seconds per segment**: 5 is a good default. **4 · Seed**: fixed = repeatable.

**Press Run once.** When it finishes, **SEGMENTS** (in group 4) holds every segment in order: click the dots under the player, or use the arrow keys, to check each one. **FULL_VIDEO** is the joined film with sound. Found a bad segment? Fix its panel or prompt and redo only that one (group 5).

The Transition boxes start empty: write one prompt per transition.

About 4 to 5 min per 5-second segment on a 16 GB GPU. If one segment is bad, fix its panel or prompt and redo just that segment (group 5).

nodes.title: MODELS & FOLDERS
widgets_values:
# Models & custom nodes

Update ComfyUI to the latest version first. This workflow uses the built-in **Start Loop / End Loop** and **Concatenate Video** nodes.

## Models (download these 4 files)

**diffusion_models**
- [fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (FastH3 V2, 8 steps)

**text_encoders**
- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

**vae**
- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

## Where they go

```
📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
    ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
    │   └── fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── 📂 text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
    └── 📂 vae/
        ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
        └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
```

## Custom nodes (Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes)
- [ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context](https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context): carries each segment into the next
- [ComfyUI-Easy-Use](https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use): grid split and switches
- [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite): only needed for option B (panels folder)
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes): the small Set / Get tags that replace long wires

nodes.title: 6 · Last segment to render (99 = to the end)
Load the segment before the first one
Save this segment for later redos
HOW TO FIX ONE SEGMENT
widgets_values:
**Full run:** First = 1, Last = 99.

**Fix one segment** (example: segment 7): fix its panel or its Transition prompt, then set First = 7 and Last = 7 and press Run. Only segment 7 renders. It continues from segment 6’s saved motion, so the join stays smooth. The result is saved as **REDO_segments**.

If you fix a segment in the middle, also redo the ones after it (First = 4, Last = 99), because each segment continues from the one before.

This needs one full run first: every run saves each segment’s motion in `output/storyboard_to_video/latents/`.
